name: pagecast
description: AI-driven assistive reading platform: any text, high-fidelity audio, word-level visual sync.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pagecast/core && npm run build -w @pagecast/api && npm run build -w @pagecast/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pagecast/core && npm run test -w @pagecast/api
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @pagecast/api & npm run dev -w @pagecast/web
